name: Will converting my garage affect my home's property value or insurance?

mainEntity.name: Will converting my garage affect my home's property value or insurance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Converting your garage into functional living space can positively impact your home's property value by increasing its habitable square footage and enhancing its overall utility and appeal, especially if the conversion is well-designed and seamlessly integrated. However, it is essential to ensure the project is properly permitted and executed by experienced professionals to maximize this value. Your home insurance provider should be informed of any significant renovation that adds square footage or changes the property's use, as this may affect your coverage and premiums. We recommend consulting with your insurer to understand any potential adjustments.
acceptedAnswer.description: A well-executed garage conversion can increase property value by adding habitable space. Inform your home insurance provider about the renovation, as it may affect coverage.
